The '''Z-95-AF4 Headhunter''', also known as the '''AF4 series''', was a variant of the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]. Manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] and [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]], it was the last starfighter of the Headhunter series to be produced before the two companies ended their partnership in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
